meta.title: A $1,000 Car Title Loan Can Cost $2,300 In Fees Alone
meta.hook: A one-thousand-dollar title loan can cost twenty-three hundred dollars in fees.
meta.description: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau found car-title loans carry average APRs near 300%, and that the average borrower renews or 'flips' the same loan about 8 times, paying roughly $2,300 in fees on a $1,000 loan. One in five borrowers has their vehicle repossessed. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: A one thousand dollar title loan can end up costing twenty-three hundred dollars in fees alone.

visual.query: car keys on cash stack close up
visual.visual_intent: Car keys resting on a stack of cash, tight macro shot, immediate visual link between vehicle and money
visual.decision_reason: hook beat: CFPB-sourced average fee figure, hard cut

scenes.narration: That's the average, not the worst case.

visual.visual_intent: A car parked quietly in a driveway at dusk, ordinary and vulnerable-looking

scenes.narration: A title loan uses your car as collateral for a short-term loan, and federal regulators found the average annual rate runs close to three hundred percent.

visual.query: loan contract paperwork signing pen close up
visual.visual_intent: A hand signing a loan contract, pen close up, formal and slightly ominous lighting
visual.decision_reason: the ~300% average APR is a CFPB-documented finding

scenes.narration: Most borrowers can't pay it off in one term, so they renew the same loan again. The average borrower does this about eight times.

visual.visual_intent: Calendar pages flipping repeatedly in sequence, visualizing a repeating cycle that doesn't resolve
visual.decision_reason: the average 8x renewal ('flipping') pattern is CFPB-documented

scenes.narration: One in five borrowers ends up losing the vehicle entirely.

visual.visual_intent: A tow truck hauling away a car on an ordinary street, stark and consequential

scenes.narration: This loan was never priced to be paid off quickly. It was priced to be renewed.

visual.query: empty driveway no car left behind
visual.visual_intent: An empty driveway where the car used to be, quiet and final, closing image
